snippet.title: Make Moku Proud Trailer - VAINSANE Fridays #2
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #2 — Make Moku Proud

A short psychological visual novel where guilt and obedience, and what it means to make Moku proud, shape the fate of a witness watching his companions disappear...

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Releasing on Mar 27, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500850/Make_Moku_Proud/
